scope: AGENTS.md repository invariant rules and code quality standards

rules.name: Default to no code comments
rules.anchor: Default to no code comments. Add a comment only after solving a bug or working through a complex issue
rules.explanation: Code should be self-documenting. Comments are reserved for non-obvious fixes, trade-offs, or upstream platform bug workarounds.
rules.condition: When writing or editing code in any language
rules.verification: Inspect git diff before declaring task completion.

rules.name: Never hand-edit generated files
rules.explanation: Generated bindings and types (e.g. tauri.ts, auto-imports.d.ts) must only be updated by generators, never edited manually.
rules.verification: Check git diff to confirm no manual edits to generated targets.

rules.name: Rust clippy-clean and post-edit checks
rules.explanation: Write clippy-clean Rust on first emission. Run cargo fmt --all and cargo check -p <crate> when touching Rust code.
rules.condition: When modifying any Rust file in apps or crates
rules.verification: Run cargo fmt --all and cargo check -p <crate> on the modified crate.

rules.name: TypeScript Biome formatting and linting
rules.anchor: Touched any TS / JS / JSON / CSS / MD file → run the narrowest applicable formatter/linter on touched files first
rules.explanation: Enforce tab indentation, double quotes, and Biome lint rules. Run bun run biome check --write on touched files.
rules.condition: When modifying TS, JS, JSON, CSS, or MD files
rules.verification: Run bun run biome check --write <files> on touched files.

rules.name: Never start additional dev servers
rules.explanation: Assume development servers (bun run dev, dev:desktop) are already running to avoid port collisions and profile locks.
rules.condition: When executing tasks or dev harness verification
rules.verification: Inspect running processes to ensure no redundant servers are spawned.
